purpose: Third-party policy embed slot for /tos, /privacy, /cookies. The original's embed is blocked by its own CSP, so the body renders 0px tall; replicated as rendered (no policy text).

contentContract.budgetRule: maxWords = longest real copy for that field in the clone (blog data: src/data/blogPosts.json) + ~20-30% headroom. Long-form body fields (article blocks, text-page items) are PLACEHOLDER in the clone, so their budgets are generation guidance, not measured against Riley's real article text.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: none-required: no section-level motion (primitive hover/press colour changes only).
motion.reducedMotionFallbackStatus: prescriptive: the source has no prefers-reduced-motion handling (grep of src/ and index.html finds none)

notes: R6 decomposition (legal header + one section per heading) does not apply: the clone renders no legal text at all, so there are no headings to split on. A generated legal page must use operator-supplied text (generation mode) and is out of this repo's measured scope.
